definitions.ask: Should Mermaid diagrams the lead drew itself also get a figure anchor and a reference sentence?
definitions.why: Matches "diagrams the linker adds"; lead diagrams are rare and already sit in lead prose

choices.label: Only figures placed from the image agent's manifest; runs without diagrams stay unchanged
Every Mermaid figure in the published file, including the lead's own, in every linker run

definitions.ask: Should the reference sentence end the paragraph the figure illustrates?
definitions.why: Reads like a paper's in-text figure reference; the caption below already labels the figure

choices.label: Appended to the anchor paragraph; its own paragraph only after lists and the bottom line
Always a one-sentence paragraph above the figure; simpler, but reads like a 2nd caption
